dict.string: Anchor uses Apple Music to fetch animated artwork for the lock screen wallpaper.
Anchor captures app audio for per-app volume controls, music visualizers and screen recordings you start. Recordings stay on your Mac unless you choose to share them.
Anchor uses the microphone for on-device dictation and, when you enable it, screen recording. Dictation stays on your Mac. Recordings stay local unless you choose to share them.
Anchor accesses desktop files only for file tools and cleanup locations you choose.
Anchor accesses network folders when you select them for file tools, capture exports or organization.
Anchor accesses removable drives when you select them for file tools, capture exports or organization.
Anchor transcribes your dictation on-device using Apple's speech recognition.
